summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing its accession as guarantor to Wise Financing plc's €2,000,000,000 Euro Medium Term Note Programme, effective August 14, 2026, following a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement making Wise Group the ultimate parent. The company also guarantees €250,000,000 of 5.100% notes due 2030, joint and several with Wise Limited and subsidiaries. This is a routine debt-program guarantor addition, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic events are involved. Watch for continued corporate reorganisation updates.
